page_title: COM 3-2 VER | Como v Verona 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' 3 - 2 Goal! Jackson Tchatchoua provides Mathis Lambourde (Verona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
90+2' Andrea Belotti (Como) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
90+2' Como earn a corner.
90+2' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Nico Paz and he is replaced by Daniele Baselli (Como).
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Maximo Perrone walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ali Jasim (Como).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Luca Mazzitelli and Andrea Belotti (Como) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 3:1.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathis Lambourde (Verona) coming on for Flavius Daniliuc.
87' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) in, Alieu Fadera out.
84' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
83' Ondrej Duda (Verona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Emil Audero to dive and make a save.
81' Antonio Giua shows the yellow card to Maximo Perrone (Como) for a heavy challenge.
78' Substitution. Andrea Belotti (Como) on for Patrick Cutrone.
78' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is replaced by Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
76' Substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) replaces Darko Lazovic.
75' Today's referee Antonio Giua rightly decides to book Diego Coppola (Verona) for his harsh tackle.
72' 2 - 1 Goal! Patrick Cutrone (Como) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
71' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
71' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) steps up to send the ball in.
69' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
69' Como take a short corner kick.
68' The ball is cleared after Alieu Fadera (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Casper Tengstedt trots off the pitch and is replaced by Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
64' Tomas Suslov (Verona) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
61' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.
59' Diego Coppola (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
57' Patrick Cutrone (Como) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

55' Darko Lazovic (Verona) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
53' 1 - 1 GOAL! Darko Lazovic (Verona) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Emil Audero.
53' Darko Lazovic (Verona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
51' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Sergi Roberto (Como).
51' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Verona!
51' Referee Antonio Giua makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Verona. Let’s see what happens!
51' One of the Verona players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
50' Great save! Nico Paz (Como) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Lorenzo Montipo.
48' A yellow card for a tackle by Reda Belahyane (Verona). Antonio Giua doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
47' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Giua blows for a foul.
46' The game is over for Grigoris Kastanos (Verona). Daniel Mosquera comes on for the second half.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a switch. Ondrej Duda is coming on in place of Dani Silva (Verona) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The free kick is delivered by Tomas Suslov (Verona) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Alieu Fadera plays it to Patrick Cutrone (Como), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lorenzo Montipo. 1:0.
42' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

40' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Como win a corner.
40' Martin Frese (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Antonio Giua signals.
39' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
36' Antonio Giua blows the whistle, Nico Paz (Como) is penalised for a foul.
34' Antonio Giua blows his whistle and signals a foul after Martin Frese (Verona) brought his opponent down.

30' Nico Paz (Como) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
29' The resulting corner, taken by Dani Silva (Verona), comes to nothing.
25' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Casper Tengstedt (Verona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

24' Sergi Roberto (Como) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
21' Nico Paz (Como) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.

20' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
19' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
19' Half-chance! Nico Paz (Como) plays a pass into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
17' Patrick Cutrone (Como) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
16' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Patrick Cutrone (Como) heads on.
16' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Sergi Roberto (Como) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Antonio Giua blows for a foul.
11' Alieu Fadera (Como) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
8' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

8' A long pass finds Alberto Moreno (Como), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the roof of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to make a good save. Como force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Como). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

7' Maximo Perrone (Como) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
7' The free kick is taken by Nico Paz (Como), but ball is cleared.

3' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
1' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Como will kick the game off.
Antonio Giua got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
